reviews.summary: SUI had a scheduled monthly supply release within the last 3 days (October 1–3, 2026). Trackers disagree on the exact amount, creating near-term supply/flow uncertainty relevant to entry timing.
materialRisks: A scheduled SUI unlock was recorded on October 1 or October 3, 2026—within the signal window—with trackers reporting approximately 13.26M to 23.4M SUI released. ([tokenomist.ai](https://tokenomist.ai/wenunlocks/sui?utm_source=openai))

The reporting discrepancy on date, amount, and allocation means the immediate released-supply impact cannot be precisely quantified from available sources. ([tokenomist.ai](https://tokenomist.ai/wenunlocks/sui?utm_source=openai))

facts.fact: Tokenomist records a 13.26M SUI unlock on October 1, 2026, equal to 0.32% of released supply. ([tokenomist.ai](https://tokenomist.ai/wenunlocks/sui?utm_source=openai))

Tokenomics.com lists an October 3, 2026 unlock in its historical schedule and identifies the next event as November 3, 2026 for 22.62M SUI. ([app.tokenomics.com](https://app.tokenomics.com/tokenomics/sui/unlocks?utm_source=openai))

The official Sui blog’s latest surfaced October 1 announcement concerns an OpenAssets/Linux Foundation collaboration, not a security incident, outage, or emergency protocol action. ([sui.io](https://www.sui.io/blog?utm_source=openai))
